# Axiom audit — Armada Transact circuit model (armada-lean)
# Generated by: lake env lean /tmp/axioms_check.lean  (Lean 4.33.1, core Lean only, no mathlib)
#
# Poseidon and Keccak are both modeled symbolically (Dolev-Yao style,
# ArmadaLean.Poseidon.Term): no `poseidon2`, `poseidon3`, `poseidon2_inj`,
# `poseidon3_inj`, or `keccak`-collision axiom exists in this project. The
# symbolic model is itself the cryptographic assumption: `Term.hash` carries a
# `HashFn` tag (`.poseidon`/`.keccak`), and inside the free algebra this tag
# keeps the two hash functions from ever colliding with each other, by
# construction (`HashFn.noConfusion`) — the same construction that already
# keeps a 2-argument Poseidon call from colliding with a 3-argument one.
# `Term.hash2`/`Term.hash3` are plain, computable definitions over an
# inductive term type; their collision resistance (`Term.hash2_inj`/
# `Term.hash3_inj`), domain separation (`HashFn.noConfusion`,
# `Term.val_ne_hash`), and preimage resistance all hold inside this model
# with no further hypothesis. The refinement from this specification to
# concrete code names these same three properties as explicit hypotheses on
# the real hash functions (docs/verification-chain.md).
#
# Expected axioms:
#   EdDSAVerify — CRYPTOGRAPHIC ASSUMPTION: EdDSA signature validity predicate
#       (unforgeability assumed, not modeled).
#   propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound — Lean core logic axioms (benign, part of
#       the trusted kernel logic).
# No 'sorryAx' anywhere: zero sorry/admit in the project.
# `msgHashOf` (Transact.circom:163-175, Poseidon(2+N+M) over the public inputs) is no
# longer an axiom either: it is defined directly as a `Term.hash` call over the
# circuit's own input packing, since `Term.hash` already represents a Poseidon call of
# any arity.

== transact_value_conserved ==
(Finding 1 fix: in-field sumIn === sumOut at Transact.circom:141-143 is a true
integer equality, given Num2Bits(120) range checks :120-129 and N ≤ 8, M ≤ 4.)
'transact_value_conserved' depends on axioms: [EdDSAVerify, propext, Quot.sound]

== transact_inputs_distinct_nullifiers ==
(Pairwise leaf distinctness within one proof, :145-161 of commit e79919d, lifts to
pairwise-distinct nullifiers of that proof :97-101 via Term.hash2's collision
resistance, proved by construction — ArmadaLean.Poseidon. One proof only: the
circuit cannot see earlier spends; the contract's spent map rejects them.)
'transact_inputs_distinct_nullifiers' depends on axioms: [EdDSAVerify]

== merkleRoot_inj_leaf ==
(A Merkle membership proof binds exactly one leaf to the root; with the root
check at Transact.circom:95 a proof cannot be moved to a different commitment.)
'merkleRoot_inj_leaf' does not depend on any axioms.

== no_wraparound_minting ==
(Range-checked sums below 2^120 with ≤ 8 inputs / ≤ 4 outputs stay below the
BN254 prime, so fieldEq of sums implies integer equality. Pure arithmetic:
depends only on Lean's core logic axioms, no cryptographic assumptions.)
'no_wraparound_minting' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== user_npk_ne_contract_npk ==
(ArmadaLean.TransactOwned, the Dolev-Yao domain-separation theorem: a user's note
key, built from a Poseidon `masterPublicKey` hash, can never equal a contract's
note key, built from a Keccak address term — two different hash-function tags on
`Term.hash` never agree, by construction, `HashFn.noConfusion`. The symbolic
model (`ArmadaLean/Poseidon.lean`'s `Term`) is the cryptographic assumption:
domain separation holds inside it with no further hypothesis.)
'user_npk_ne_contract_npk' does not depend on any axioms.

# Note: transact_value_conserved / transact_inputs_distinct_nullifiers mention EdDSAVerify only
# because their statements quantify over the `Constrained` constraint structure, which
# itself references that symbol (the circuit's signature check, `Constrained.sig`); the
# value and distinct-nullifier arguments themselves use only the range-check, distinctness, and
# Term.hash2_inj facts, none of which are axioms.
